name: Ethylene glycol
about: Points sampled from the source of each property record (or the source's own tabulated values) by validation/python/fit_properties.py. test/properties.test.js checks that the coefficients in src/data/components.json reproduce them within the maximum deviation stated in each record.

source.name: ChemSep v8.3 pure-component database
source.reference: Kooijman and Taylor, ChemSep v8.3, chemsep1.xml (2021), via https://github.com/DanWBR/dwsim (DWSIM.Thermodynamics/Assets/Databases)
source.fit: ChemSep equation 105 coefficients taken over unchanged except: A converted from kmol/m3 to kg/m3 with the ChemSep molar mass 62.0678 kg/kmol.; reproduces ChemSep within 0.0001 % at 200 points 260.15-695.80 K
source.chain: CoolProp 8.0.0: fluid not included; NIST WebBook: no data
source.measuredCheck: NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (validation/python/check_measured.py): 378 measured values from 75 articles, 273.1-473.1 K; median deviation of the articles 0.02 % (within the 1 % tolerance of the engineering report); largest single deviation +0.93 % at 353.1 K (Yang 2003, doi:10.1021/je020140j); docs/MEASURED_CHECKS.md
